title: They didn't take 18%. They took the guest.
styleLine: ONE CONSISTENT LINE ACROSS ALL IMAGES (critical). Cinematic editorial photography, shot as if by the SAME photographer on the SAME 35mm lens, same warm natural grade — deep navy shadows (#262B38) + warm cream light (#F7F8EA), rich but natural (NOT a heavy Instagram filter, NOT washed-out, NOT HDR). Modern boutique-hotel world: walnut wood, cream plaster, greenery, contemporary fixtures. NO dated props (no key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash). Elegant, quiet, expensive. 4:5 aspect (1080x1350), designed for Instagram feed carousels (full frame visible) and TikTok photo carousels. SAFE ZONES: (a) Instagram profile grid crops to CENTER 1:1 — the top ~135px and bottom ~135px are cropped in the grid view, so keep the hero subject center-frame. (b) TikTok photo mode overlays a caption/UI region across the bottom ~340px on the visible feed — keep any critical visual detail above that band. (c) The lower ~40% of the frame (roughly y=810 to y=1350 on a 1080x1350 canvas) is reserved for on-slide type — compose the subject in the upper ~55-60% but fill the ENTIRE frame with natural scene content — NO dark band, NO black rectangle, NO artificial dark area. A CSS gradient handles text legibility. No text, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces.
note: Path B. All six slides are pure photos. No device composite in this one.

slides.imagePrompt: A calm modern boutique-hotel lobby in warm morning light, walnut furniture, cream plaster, a large plant, layered lighting. Empty of people. A single guest has just walked past, out of frame. Editorial and quiet. Compose the subject in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame. CRITICAL: fill the ENTIRE frame with natural scene content — NO dark band, NO black rectangle, NO artificial dark area at the bottom. A CSS overlay handles text readability. [Apply the STYLE LINE.]
slides.headline:
They didn't take ==18%==.
They took the ==guest==.
slides.sub: The commission is the visible cost. The invisible one is the person.

Editorial, no readable text on the paper. Compose the subject in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame. slides.title: You saw ==the invoice==
slides.body: The line item labeled 'commission.' Fifty dollars on every two-hundred-dollar booking. Painful, countable, easy to explain to yourself.

slides.title: You didn't see ==the profile==
slides.body: Their email. Their preferences. Their birthday. The room they liked. The reason they came. Booking kept all of it. You got a booking reference.

slides.title: So next year, you ==buy them back==
slides.body: Same guest, same room, another eighteen percent. That's not a commission, it's a subscription to a customer who was already yours.

The notebook pages are completely blank — no writing. Compose the subject in the UPPER ~55-60% of the frame. slides.title: A direct booking is a ==profile==
slides.body: Email in your CRM. Preference in your record. Birthday in your calendar. A person you can write to before the next season.

What do you ==know== about your
last direct guest?
